title: Register products
goal: What every customer bought, which version and when, is either known from the records or asked of the founder, and every open case names the product it is about.

steps.do: Read the customer, deal and product records and write, per customer, what they bought, which version and when, naming every customer whose purchase the records cannot say.
Ask the founder what the unknown customers bought and when, taking the ones with an open case first, and record each answer on its case rather than guessing a version.
On every open case record the product and the version the contact is about, so a contact reason can later be counted per version instead of per customer.

Report how many customers have a known purchase and how many do not, name the decision this bears on, and recommend to the growth lead whether keeping a purchase record is worth the founder's time yet.

done_criteria.check: Does every open case name the product and version it is about, and is every customer whose purchase is unknown listed for the founder?
